title: What is the context window of Orion-7?

data.query: What is the context window of Orion-7?
data.answer:
Orion-7 supports a context window of 512,000 tokens and is available through the company's API from today. [1]

### Details
- Northwind Labs unveiled Orion-6, its newest model at the time, with a 128,000-token context window. [2]
- In Wayland the compositor is also the display server, while X11 separates the X server from the window manager and compositor. [3]
